blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Defense Secretary Gilberto Teodoro Jr. on Friday challenged China to disclose the alleged business and financial dealings of some Philippine politicians with Beijing. He also questioned whether the reported threat was intended to destabilize the country. “Let them disclose it. Then, we will find out whether the allegations are true or whether they are actually trying to destabilize the country,” Teodoro said in a virtual interview with reporters. The defense chief was asked about a report by the Manila-based Chinese Commercial News that Beijing was considering 10 possible counter-measures against the Philippines.
